entries.title: Any steward can close advice on someone else's proposal before its deadline, and is told 'You decide when advice closes'
entries.rootCause: By design today: PROPOSAL_LIFECYCLE advice->consent (neos_agent/services/act_gates.py:143) is a manual move under the manage rule (author or mod+ steward: policy.can_manage_proposal, api/policy.py:63-67; enforced act_gates.py:342), documented as 'manage rule: the proposer closes advice' (services/AGENTS.md:23). The page prompt tells anyone who can close 'You decide when advice closes' (client/src/lib/proposal-vocab.ts:186-198) and the move runs on one click (pages/governance/proposals/ProposalDetail.tsx:921,1058).
entries.rationale: The owner decision (uxqa/governance/plan.md:21) says the proposer closes advice and the deadline only prompts; the implementation lets any steward close it at any time. Whether a non-author steward may close advice (never, only after the deadline, or with a reason and the proposer told) is policy, so triage does not narrow the authority (no feature removed). The misleading copy and the missing confirmation are fixed now under p2-repair-bench-across-ecosystems-6 and p2-stewards-confirm-and-register-16 (a non-author steward is told they act for the proposer).
entries.ownerQuestion: May a steward who did not write a proposal close its advice phase; if so, only after the advice deadline, with a recorded reason, and with the proposer told?
entries.ownerDecision: 2026-11-01: stewards close advice only after a set deadline has passed; no deadline means proposer only

entries.title: The proposer's own consent alone completes the consent round and moves the proposal to Test; the bell asks the proposer to record it
entries.rootCause: neos_agent/services/act_gates.py:417-418 DEFAULT_PROPOSAL_QUORUM = 1 ('Owner default'); record_consent_position (:587-603) has no author check and the consent gate counts every non-withdrawn position (:467-478); consent->test is automatic (:144); next_steps.proposal_items asks every participant, the author included, to record a position (services/next_steps.py:412-418).
entries.rationale: Matches the shipped default; whether it is legitimate is policy (synthesis F02, all four lenses agree). Precedent: pass 01 refused self-advice (p1-expert-first-week-audit-12). Owner chooses: exclude the author's position from the gate and the bell, require at least one non-author position, or raise the default quorum. The interaction half (warn before the completing click, no preselected Consent) is fixed under p2-lending-rules-keyboard-4.
entries.ownerQuestion: Should the author's own consent position count toward the consent gate (and be prompted by the bell), and is a default quorum of 1 intended?
entries.ownerDecision: 2026-11-01: the author's own consent position counts toward the quorum (keep)

entries.title: A pending_consent member's advice and consent are accepted by the participation rule (reported symptom misattributed; latent rule gap confirmed)

Lane 1: can_participate requires an active row; advice, consent, test and create refuse a pending row with 403 code CONSENT_PENDING in plain words, in REST, MCP and the assistant; actor x action test table (active, pending row, shared-ecosystem member without a row).

entries.ownerQuestion: Is a held agreement ceremony a step members record (and required before 'in force'), or are ceremonies the recorded stage moves?
entries.ownerDecision: 2026-11-01: no separate ceremony action; copy says ceremonies are the recorded stage moves

entries.title: Sidebar identity keeps the old display name after the profile is saved
entries.rootCause: Profile save writes users.display_name (neos_agent/api/profiles.py setattr on user, ~:391) and updates only the profile cache (client/src/pages/Profile.tsx:122-131); the shell and governance records read the per-ecosystem members.display_name (client/src/components/AppSidebar.tsx:240), which the profile never changes, so a session refresh would not help.
entries.rationale: Not a refresh bug but an identity question: should the public profile name rename the member rows in every ecosystem (governance pages show those names), or are per-ecosystem names intended? Owner decides before code.
entries.ownerQuestion: Should saving the public profile name also rename the person's member rows in each ecosystem?
entries.ownerDecision: 2026-11-01: the profile name renames the member in every ecosystem
